mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.status, r.view_count, COUNT(rcoll.id) AS collection_count, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_collection rcoll ON r.id = rcoll.route_id AND rcoll.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.status, r.view_count, COUNT(rcoll.id) AS collection_count, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_collection rcoll ON r.id = rcoll.route_id AND rcoll.deleted = 0 WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0 GROUP BY r.id

SELECT rsr.day_number, JSON_ARRAYAGG( JSON_OBJECT( 'scenicId', s.id, 'scenicName', s.name, 'location', s.location, 'price', s.price, 'description', rsr.description, 'sortOrder', rsr.sort_order ) ) AS day_plan FROM route_scenic_relation rsr LEFT JOIN scenic s ON rsr.scenic_id = s.id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE rsr.route_id = #{routeId} GROUP BY rsr.day_number ORDER BY rsr.day_number

SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.status, r.view_count, COUNT(rcoll.id) AS collection_count, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_collection rcoll ON r.id = rcoll.route_id AND rcoll.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.category_id, rc.name AS category_name, r.budget, r.duration_days, r.best_season, r.images, r.status, r.view_count, COUNT(rcoll.id) AS collection_count, r.create_time FROM travel_route r LEFT JOIN route_category rc ON r.category_id = rc.id LEFT JOIN route_collection rcoll ON r.id = rcoll.route_id AND rcoll.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN route_scenic_relation rsr ON r.id = rsr.route_id LEFT JOIN scenic_tag_relation str ON rsr.scenic_id = str.scenic_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND ( r.category_id IN ( SELECT category_id FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND category_id IS NOT NULL ) OR str.tag_id IN ( SELECT tag_id FROM user_preference WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND tag_id IS NOT NULL ) ) GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.view_count DESC, r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_route SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
